title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Find Usages, up to twice as fast again
summary: The line state decision at the heart of the usage scan is read one character code at a time instead of three string comparisons per position.

highlights.title: Between 21 and 48 percent off the scan
highlights.description: Measured in interleaved passes against the previous release, every distribution disjoint: the class reference scan drops 48 percent, and nothing in the family gains less than 21.

highlights.title: The same answer, to the character
highlights.description: The routine it replaces is kept as the oracle in the test file: the new one has to agree with it on 60 000 deliberately malformed lines in each of the three entry states.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Find Usages and the reference scans are between a fifth and half as expensive again.
The correctness fix that made them expensive is untouched: a triple quote written inside a comment still opens nothing.
